limitations: This five-case reviewer-owned set measures only the current charter artifacts; it is not a claim of broad vulnerability coverage.
A current run with different reviewed findings must receive a new reviewed cases/gold version rather than reuse this acceptance set.
improvement_proposals: Expand the reviewer-owned set only after adding independently reviewed current-run findings and benign controls.
Add a receipt-specific case once the controller publishes a sanitized Kong receipt artifact in the run directory.
